name: ePub Generator: Markdown
description: Converts uploaded Markdown (.md) files to ePub ebooks, with a file-field formatter and YAML front matter support.
project_description: The Markdown submodule of ePub Generator converts uploaded Markdown files to ePub ebooks. It adds a "Markdown with ePub download" field formatter for file fields that shows a "Download as ePub" link beside any .md/.markdown file, and a download route that converts the file on request. Conversion uses league/commonmark (CommonMark core plus GitHub-Flavored Markdown). Markdown may begin with YAML front matter for book metadata (title, author(s), publisher, ISBN, edition, description, rights/copyright, language, date, subjects/tags, and layout settings), and content is split into chapters on # headings, with ## headings becoming nested sub-chapters. Requires the base ePub Generator module and the league/commonmark Composer package.
